integrity: Mathematical argument is self-contained; finite rational checker corroborates but does not replace all-parameter Fourier, Vandermonde and boundary proof. Classical identities and references explicitly acknowledged. No independent scientific audit performed.
scientific_limitations: All positive electrical resistances on cycles, and the corresponding continuous resistance circle; no claimed exact finite supremal exponent for n>=4; no extension to arbitrary weighted graphs. One relevant circulant paper only abstract-inspected. Earlier foundational literature has incomplete first-day dating, so the first precisely date-verified public source among the dated research references is 2006-09-05.
title: Weighted electrical cycles: strict Euclidean resistance metrics, exact simplex spectra, and a sharp continuum boundary
